import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_46/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_46/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source3_46_0 and Source3_46_1 on 'city'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by city, driver_count, type and aggregate average fare and ride count
result = df_joined.groupby(
    ["city", "driver_count", "type"], as_index=False
).agg(
    {
        "fare": "mean",
        "ride_id": "count"
    }
)

# Rename columns to match target schema
result.rename(columns={"fare": "Average Fare", "ride_id": "Ride Count"}, inplace=True)

# Ensure correct data types
result["city"] = result["city"].astype(str)
result["driver_count"] = result["driver_count"].astype(int)
result["type"] = result["type"].astype(str)
result["Average Fare"] = result["Average Fare"].astype(float)
result["Ride Count"] = result["Ride Count"].astype(int)

# Save to target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_46/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_46/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_46/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to avoid extra rows)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='city')

# Group by city, driver_count, type (leftmost non-float unique columns in target)
# Aggregate average fare and count of ride_id
result = joined.groupby(['city', 'driver_count', 'type'], as_index=False).agg(
    **{
        'Average Fare': ('fare', 'mean'),
        'Ride Count': ('ride_id', 'count')
    }
)

# Write output with exact target schema column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_46/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
